values.note: $35 Thursday-Sunday; $20 Monday-Wednesday on non-holiday nights from June to December. Dump station use included; boat launch fee extra.

fees.source: https://parks.ocontocountywi.gov/parks/camping/north_bay_shore_county_park/ ('Single Site Rates Monday - Wednesday $20 (Non Holiday June - December) Thursday - Sunday $35'; 'RV Dump Station (fee included in reservation)'; 'Boat Launch (launch fee is not included in the camping fee)')

hookups.source: Oconto County site search: every listed site 'Electricity: Yes', 30 or 50 amps (50 at sites 2, 4, 31-34); 'Water Hook-up: Yes' at most sites (not 12, 14-21)

values.note: All sites have electric; most also have water. Posted lengths run from under 20 ft (sites 14 and 19-21) to 46-48 ft (site 7); about half are blacktop. Plus a group site.

sites.source: https://parks.ocontocountywi.gov/parks/camping/north_bay_shore_county_park/ ('There are 34 daily sites and a group site'); site search ('Max Unit Length' buckets, 'Up to 20'' at 14, 19, 20, 21, '46-48'' at site 7; 'Blacktop Site'); campground map legend (Blacktop/Electric/Water, Water/Electric, Blacktop/Electric, Electric)

values.note: Coin-operated showers. The water is shut off from late fall until spring.

facilities.source: https://parks.ocontocountywi.gov/parks/camping/north_bay_shore_county_park/ ('Restrooms (vaulted & flush) Water available to fill campers at bathrooms ... Coin Operated Showers RV Dump Station'; 'The water at Chute Pond, North Bay Shore Campground and fish cleaning station has been shut off and will remain off until weather permits in the spring')

values.note: Online reservations close 2 days before arrival; any open site can be self-registered at the automated pay station by the boat launch. From October 15 to November 30 every stay is self-registered. Staffed Memorial Day to Labor Day.

booking.source: https://parks.ocontocountywi.gov/parks/camping/north_bay_shore_county_park/ ('Campers may make reservations up to a year in advance (from the start date), and reserve for a minimum of two nights (three nights on holiday weekends) and a maximum of 14 days. Reservations are made online, 2 days prior to your arrival. Campers can self-register at the campgound for an open site, and must pay at the automated pay station located at the boat launch.'; 'Campers wishing to camp between October 15th and November 30th must self-register'; 'Campground is staffed from Memorial Day - Labor Day')

note: Oconto County park on the west shore of Green Bay north of Oconto, beside a breakwater harbor with a boat launch and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: County page + site search + map: 34 sites, all electric (30/50A), most with water, $20 Mon-Wed / $35 Thu-Sun, coin showers, dump, reservable a year out (2-night min, 3 holiday, 14 max), self-register for open sites. Bayfront -> bayview: a continuous shore band of trees, shrubs and reed marsh separates the loop from the bay.
flags: WATERFRONT bayfront -> bayview (downgrade). Map: the south-row sites (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 16, 17, all nightly) face the shore. On Esri imagery that row (about 44.9632,-87.7800 to 44.9640,-87.7775) is separated from open Green Bay by a continuous band of trees and shrubs and then reed marsh, roughly 60-90 m from site to open water; sites 1-3 at the west end sit about 30 m from the harbor basin but behind the tree line along its east bank, with the playground and paths between. No site has an open apron to the water. If even the view is blocked in summer, 'not waterfront' is the alternative.
BOOKING fcfs 'after_cutoff' -> 'always' (per the brief's allowed values); the 2-day cutoff is in the note and the stored reserve_until (-48 h) stands.
SEASON: the page gives no opening date. Water is shut off for winter and October 15-November 30 is self-register only, so no season group is written.
PHONE 920-834-6995 and WEBSITE confirmed (the county page lists the same number for reservations).
PIN 44.9635,-87.7819 sits at the loop entrance, about 90 m from the loop's center; kept.
MIN STAY: 2 nights for every reservation, which a self-registered walk-up avoids; no 3+ night standing minimum.
